title: ExecuTorch WebGPU: export a PyTorch model once and run the same .pte file in Chrome and Safari
headline: ExecuTorch WebGPU runs exported PyTorch models in browsers
lede: You can export a PyTorch model once with torch.export and run the same .pte file locally in Chrome and Safari, with on-device LoRA fine-tuning.

effects.effect: Less server inference for small models
Browser tabs become a deployment target for PyTorch models
Vision and speech models run client side

possibilities.title: Browser apps ship private on-device image models with per-user LoRA tuning

possibilities.connection: ExecuTorch WebGPU runs exported PyTorch models in Chrome and Safari with on-device LoRA, and Unsloth trains diffusion models locally, so one pipeline trains then ships a model that never leaves the browser.
